# Drawing

The renderer-neutral drawing vocabulary: bitmaps, brushes, paths, painters, framebuffers and live surfaces.

(api-gui-drawing-bitmap)=
## Bitmap

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/drawing/bitmap/bitmap.hpp>
class Bitmap final : public DrawingObject
```

Bitmap owns bounded premultiplied pixel storage, stable identity and generation, exclusive read/write locks, rollback-capable rectangular edit leases, exact changed-byte damage derivation, bounded damage history, transforms, cloning, and immutable snapshots.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `Bitmap(std::uint32_t width, std::uint32_t height, PixelFormat pixel_format = PixelFormat::bgra32_premultiplied)` | Validates dimensions/format/byte extent, allocates zeroed storage, and assigns nonzero stable identity. |
| `std::uint32_t width() const` | Requires liveness and returns pixel width. |
| `std::uint32_t height() const` | Requires liveness and returns pixel height. |
| `PixelFormat pixel_format() const` | Requires liveness and returns the admitted premultiplied layout. |
| `std::uint64_t generation() const` | Requires liveness and returns the current published mutation generation. |
| `Color get_pixel(std::uint32_t x, std::uint32_t y) const` | Requires liveness, no conflicting write state, and valid coordinates, then decodes one premultiplied pixel. |
| `void set_pixel(std::uint32_t x, std::uint32_t y, Color color)` | Prepares exclusive mutation, writes one pixel, and publishes exact one-pixel damage only for a changed value. |
| `void make_transparent(Color key)` | Transforms matching RGB pixels to transparent and publishes conservative changed runs. |
| `std::unique_ptr<Bitmap> clone(RectI source) const` | Validates a source rectangle and copies it into independent identity/storage. |
| `std::unique_ptr<Bitmap> thumbnail(std::uint32_t width, std::uint32_t height) const` | Validates target dimensions and creates a deterministic nearest-sampled independent bitmap. |
| `std::unique_ptr<Bitmap> adjusted(const ImageAttributes& attributes) const` | Applies a retained color matrix/remap snapshot into independent storage. |
| `BitmapLockView lock(BitmapLockMode mode)` | Rejects nested leases, creates a nonzero token, and returns read and optional mutable storage according to lock mode. |
| `void unlock(std::uint64_t token)` | Requires the exact active token and publishes full damage only for a writable lease. |
| `bool locked() const` | Reports whether any lock or edit lease is active. |
| `BitmapEditView begin_edit(RectI bounds)` | Validates a nonempty rectangle, snapshots its original bytes for rollback, and returns a bounded writable lease. |
| `std::uint64_t commit_edit(std::uint64_t token)` | Requires the exact edit token, compares backup/current bytes, derives bounded changed rectangles, publishes one generation, and retires the lease. |
| `void cancel_edit(std::uint64_t token)` | Requires the exact edit token, restores backup bytes exactly, and retires without publication. |
| `BitmapDamageSnapshot changes_since(std::uint64_t generation) const` | Returns bounded accumulated damage after a generation and marks history incomplete when the requested baseline aged out. |
| `ImageSnapshot snapshot() const` | Returns immutable shared pixel storage plus stable identity, dimensions, format, and generation. |

**Protected members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `void on_dispose() noexcept override` | Drops storage, backup, damage history, and active lease state without throwing. |

**Data members**

```cpp
static constexpr std::uint32_t maximum_dimension = 32768;
static constexpr std::uint64_t maximum_pixels = 100'000'000ULL;
static constexpr std::uint64_t maximum_bytes = maximum_pixels * 4ULL;
static constexpr std::size_t maximum_damage_rectangles = 256;
static constexpr std::size_t maximum_damage_history = 256;
```

(api-gui-drawing-drawingobject)=
## DrawingObject

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/drawing/object/drawing_object.hpp>
class DrawingObject
```

DrawingObject is the thread-affine disposable base for mutable drawing resources, with explicit alive/disposing/disposed transitions and controlled serialized handoff.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `DrawingObject()` | Captures the constructing thread as the initial exclusive owner; copying is prohibited. |
| `virtual ~DrawingObject()` | Provides polymorphic destruction without implicitly invoking application-visible disposal work. |
| `void dispose()` | Verifies thread access, performs the single alive-to-disposing-to-disposed transition, and calls the subtype cleanup hook once. |
| `ObjectState state() const` | Verifies access and returns the authoritative lifecycle phase. |
| `bool is_disposed() const` | Verifies access and reports terminal disposal. |
| `std::thread::id owner_thread() const noexcept` | Returns the current exclusive owner thread identity. |
| `void verify_access() const` | Throws when mutable drawing state is touched from a nonowner thread. |
| `void handoff_to_current_thread()` | Transfers serialized ownership to the caller's thread; it does not authorize concurrent access. |

**Protected members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `void require_alive() const` | Requires owner-thread access and the alive phase. |
| `virtual void on_dispose() noexcept` | Provides the no-throw subtype cleanup hook. |

(api-gui-drawing-graphicspath)=
## GraphicsPath

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/drawing/graphics_path/graphics_path.hpp>
class GraphicsPath final : public DrawingObject
```

GraphicsPath is a bounded retained vector-geometry state machine with explicit figure boundaries, line/quadratic/cubic/polygon/rectangle/ellipse/arc/pie vocabulary, affine transformation, hit testing, cloning, bounds, and immutable snapshots.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `explicit GraphicsPath(FillMode fill_mode = FillMode::alternate)` | Validates and retains the initial fill rule. |
| `FillMode fill_mode() const` | Requires liveness and returns alternate or winding fill policy. |
| `void set_fill_mode(FillMode fill_mode)` | Validates and commits fill policy. |
| `void reset()` | Clears all retained elements while preserving fill policy. |
| `void start_figure()` | Appends an explicit new-figure marker. |
| `void close_figure()` | Appends a close marker when a figure is active. |
| `void add_line(PointF from, PointF to)` | Validates and appends an authored line segment. |
| `void add_quadratic(PointF from, PointF control, PointF to)` | Validates and appends one quadratic Bézier segment. |
| `void add_bezier(PointF from, PointF control1, PointF control2, PointF to)` | Validates and appends one cubic Bézier segment. |
| `void add_beziers(std::span<const PointF> points)` | Validates the 3n+1 point law and appends cubic segments transactionally. |
| `void add_polygon(std::span<const PointF> points)` | Validates a bounded polygon, starts it, appends lines, and closes it. |
| `void add_rectangle(RectF rectangle)` | Validates and appends a rectangle element. |
| `void add_ellipse(RectF bounds)` | Validates and appends an ellipse element. |
| `void add_arc(RectF bounds, double start_angle, double sweep_angle)` | Validates bounds/angles and appends an arc element. |
| `void add_pie(RectF bounds, double start_angle, double sweep_angle)` | Builds a closed center-to-arc pie figure from validated geometry. |
| `void add_path(const GraphicsPath& path, bool connect)` | Copies another live snapshot with optional connection while enforcing total element capacity. |
| `void transform(const Matrix& matrix)` | Requires a finite matrix and transforms every retained geometry field. |
| `bool is_visible(PointF point) const` | Projects a snapshot through deterministic fill-rule hit testing. |
| `std::vector<PointF> path_points() const` | Flattens retained element control/end points into an inspectable ordered vector. |
| `std::unique_ptr<GraphicsPath> clone() const` | Creates an independent path with identical fill policy and elements. |
| `RectF bounds() const` | Computes conservative bounds across every retained geometry form. |
| `PathSnapshot snapshot() const` | Copies fill rule and the complete immutable element sequence. |

(api-gui-drawing-graphicsrecorder)=
## GraphicsRecorder

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/drawing/graphics_recorder/graphics_recorder.hpp>
class GraphicsRecorder final : public DrawingObject
```

GraphicsRecorder is a bounded thread-affine command transaction with explicit save-token stack discipline, retained transform/clip/quality state, validated resource snapshots, deterministic trace output, and a terminal close phase.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `GraphicsRecorder() = default` | Constructs an open recorder with identity transform and default quality state. |
| `GraphicsStateToken save()` | Enforces stack capacity, allocates a nonzero token, retains current state, and records the save command. |
| `void restore(GraphicsStateToken token)` | Requires LIFO exact-token ownership, restores state, and records the transition. |
| `void translate(double x, double y)` | Validates and composes translation before recording it. |
| `void set_transform(Matrix transform)` | Requires a finite matrix, commits it, and records the state change. |
| `void set_clip(RectF clip)` | Validates and commits a finite clip rectangle. |
| `void reset_clip()` | Clears retained clipping and records the reset. |
| `void set_quality(SmoothingMode smoothing, InterpolationMode interpolation, PixelOffsetMode pixel_offset, CompositingMode compositing, CompositingQuality compositing_quality)` | Validates every closed quality/compositing vocabulary and records their atomic state update. |
| `GraphicsState current_state() const` | Requires an open live recorder and returns transform, clip, and quality state. |
| `bool is_visible(PointF point) const` | Tests a point against current optional clip. |
| `SizeF measure_string(std::string_view utf8, const Font& font, const StringFormat& format, const TextMetricsProvider& provider) const` | Validates UTF-8/resource liveness and delegates immutable snapshots to the supplied metrics provider. |
| `void clear(Color color)` | Records a surface clear color. |
| `void fill_rectangle(const Brush& brush, RectF rect)` | Validates bounds and snapshots a live brush into a fill command. |
| `void draw_rectangle(const Pen& pen, RectF rect)` | Validates bounds and snapshots a live pen into a stroke command. |
| `void draw_line(const Pen& pen, PointF from, PointF to)` | Validates endpoints and snapshots a live pen. |
| `void draw_string(std::string_view utf8, const Font& font, const SolidBrush& brush, PointF origin, const StringFormat& format)` | Validates bounded UTF-8 and origin, then owns text plus font/brush/format snapshots. |
| `void draw_ellipse(const Pen& pen, RectF bounds)` | Validates bounds and records a pen snapshot. |
| `void fill_ellipse(const Brush& brush, RectF bounds)` | Validates bounds and records a brush snapshot. |
| `void fill_polygon(const Brush& brush, std::span<const PointF> points, FillMode fill_mode = FillMode::alternate)` | Validates bounded finite points/fill rule and owns points plus brush snapshot. |
| `void draw_path(const Pen& pen, const GraphicsPath& path)` | Owns live pen and path snapshots. |
| `void fill_path(const Brush& brush, const GraphicsPath& path)` | Owns live brush and path snapshots. |
| `void draw_image(const ImageReference& image, RectF destination, RectF source, const ImageAttributes& attributes)` | Owns ImageReference or Bitmap snapshot, validated source/destination geometry, and ImageAttributes snapshot. |
| `void draw_image(const Bitmap& image, RectF destination, RectF source, const ImageAttributes& attributes)` | Owns ImageReference or Bitmap snapshot, validated source/destination geometry, and ImageAttributes snapshot. |
| `void close()` | Requires balanced saved state and enters terminal closed state. |
| `bool closed() const` | Reports terminal recorder state. |
| `std::span<const DrawingCommand> commands() const` | Returns the immutable recorded command span. |
| `std::string deterministic_trace() const` | Serializes state and commands with stable numeric/resource vocabulary for equivalence tests. |

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `void on_dispose() noexcept override` | Clears commands/state stack and terminally closes without throwing. |

```cpp
std::uint32_t width{};

```

| `~LiveSurfaceFrame() = default` | Releases the shared buffer lease; no producer coordination or callback occurs. |
| `LiveSurfaceFrame(LiveSurfaceFrame&&) noexcept = default` | Constructs an empty lease, moves a lease, rejects copying, or privately binds one immutable buffer to exact epoch, generation, and damage metadata. |
| `LiveSurfaceFrame& operator=(LiveSurfaceFrame&&) noexcept = default` | Moves or rejects copying according to exclusive lease-handle ownership. |
| `explicit operator bool() const noexcept` | Reports whether an immutable buffer is currently retained. |
| `std::uint32_t width() const noexcept` | Returns the retained buffer width or zero for an empty lease. |
| `std::uint32_t height() const noexcept` | Returns the retained buffer height or zero for an empty lease. |
| `std::uint64_t row_bytes() const noexcept` | Returns the exact byte stride or zero for an empty lease. |
| `LiveSurfacePixelFormat pixel_format() const noexcept` | Returns the admitted BGRA premultiplied-sRGB format for retained and empty leases. |
| `bool opaque() const noexcept` | This frame's promise remains valid across surface reconfiguration. |
| `std::uint64_t epoch() const noexcept` | Returns the configuration epoch sampled with the publication. |
| `std::uint64_t generation() const noexcept` | Returns the monotonically published generation within the sampled epoch. |
| `Rect damage() const noexcept` | Returns the newest publication's damage from acquire_latest, or the invalid region taken by acquire_for_presentation, clipped to surface bounds. |
| `std::span<const std::byte> pixels() const noexcept` | Returns a const byte span whose lifetime is protected by the retained shared buffer. |

(api-gui-forms-livesurfacesnapshot)=
## LiveSurfaceSnapshot

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/live_surface/types/live_surface_types.hpp>
struct LiveSurfaceSnapshot final
```

LiveSurfaceSnapshot reports immutable configuration, epoch and generation identity, publish/drop/read counters, newest sampled generation, and current writer/frame availability.

**Data members**

```cpp
LiveSurfaceDescription description{};
std::uint64_t epoch{};
std::uint64_t published_generation{};
std::uint64_t publishes{};
std::uint64_t dropped_acquires{};
std::uint64_t read_acquires{};
// Newest generation ever sampled by a terminal renderer. This is a sampling diagnostic, not a compositor-present acknowledgement.
std::uint64_t last_read_generation{};
bool write_active{};
bool has_frame{};
// True between reconfigure and the first publication of the new epoch, while acquire_latest()/acquire_for_presentation() return the previous epoch's last frame (at its own size) instead of nothing.
bool carries_previous_frame{};
```

(api-gui-forms-livesurfacewakeconnection)=
## LiveSurfaceWakeConnection

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/live_surface/wake_connection/live_surface_wake_connection.hpp>
class LiveSurfaceWakeConnection final
```

LiveSurfaceWakeConnection is the move-only revocable ownership edge between a producer publication and a retained consumer's best-effort scheduling signal.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `LiveSurfaceWakeConnection() = default` | Constructs a disconnected token, moves exclusive connection ownership, or privately binds one state/wake pair for LiveSurface. |
| `~LiveSurfaceWakeConnection()` | Disconnects idempotently so token retirement cannot retain a stale consumer callback. |
| `LiveSurfaceWakeConnection(LiveSurfaceWakeConnection&&) noexcept` | Constructs a disconnected token, moves exclusive connection ownership, or privately binds one state/wake pair for LiveSurface. |
| `LiveSurfaceWakeConnection& operator=(LiveSurfaceWakeConnection&&) noexcept` | Disconnects any prior connection before taking move ownership; copying is prohibited. |
| `bool connected() const noexcept` | Reads the wake's atomic revocation bit without entering the surface mutex. |
| `void disconnect() noexcept` | Atomically revokes delivery, erases the exact wake sequence under the state mutex when the surface remains alive, and releases both ownership edges. |

(api-gui-forms-livesurfacewritelease)=
## LiveSurfaceWriteLease

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/live_surface/write_lease/live_surface_write_lease.hpp>
class LiveSurfaceWriteLease final
```

LiveSurfaceWriteLease is a move-only exclusive producer candidate; publish commits complete pixels atomically, while destruction or abandon returns the slot without publishing.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `LiveSurfaceWriteLease() = default` | Constructs an empty token, moves exclusive ownership, rejects copying, or privately binds the state, buffer slot, and configuration epoch selected by LiveSurface. |
| `~LiveSurfaceWriteLease()` | Abandons an unpublished candidate so producer failure cannot strand the writing slot. |
| `LiveSurfaceWriteLease(LiveSurfaceWriteLease&& other) noexcept` | Constructs an empty token, moves exclusive ownership, rejects copying, or privately binds the state, buffer slot, and configuration epoch selected by LiveSurface. |
| `LiveSurfaceWriteLease& operator=(LiveSurfaceWriteLease&& other) noexcept` | Abandons any current candidate before taking move ownership; copying is prohibited. |
| `explicit operator bool() const noexcept` | Reports whether state and candidate buffer ownership are both current. |
| `std::uint32_t width() const noexcept` | Returns candidate width or zero for an empty lease. |
| `std::uint32_t height() const noexcept` | Returns candidate height or zero for an empty lease. |
| `std::uint64_t row_bytes() const noexcept` | Returns candidate stride or zero for an empty lease. |
| `std::span<std::byte> pixels() noexcept` | Returns the mutable candidate byte span; these bytes remain invisible until publish succeeds. |
| `std::uint64_t publish(Rect damage = {})` | Validates epoch, slot, and buffer identity under the mutex, clips/defaults damage, advances generation, releases producer ownership, then invokes copied best-effort wakes outside the mutex. |
| `void abandon() noexcept` | Clears the writing slot only when this lease still owns the current epoch and releases candidate state without changing publication identity. |
